The '''''Reptavian''''' was a [[Republic-class Star Destroyer|''Republic''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]]. It was one of the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that answered the call to aid the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]'' when [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bylsma (New Republic)|Bylsma]] sent out a request for support to [[Battle of Shramar|defend]] [[Shramar]].<ref name="Revelation 3" />
